source.sqlReaderQuery:
SELECT (SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'CAREADVANCE_DM_CM_ASSIGN_ContainerName' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'PDS_Load_CareAdvance_CM_ASSIGN' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'Stage_Members_5') AS CAREADVANCE_DM_CM_ASSIGN_ContainerName,
(SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'CAREADVANCE_DM_CM_ASSIGN_FileName' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'PDS_Load_CareAdvance_CM_ASSIGN' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'Stage_Members_5') AS CAREADVANCE_DM_CM_ASSIGN_FileName,
(SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'CAREADVANCE_DM_CM_ASSIGN_FilePath' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'PDS_Load_CareAdvance_CM_ASSIGN' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'Stage_Members_5') AS CAREADVANCE_DM_CM_ASSIGN_FilePath,
(SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'PDS_CAREADVANCE_CM_ASSIGN_ContainerName' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'PDS_Load_CareAdvance_CM_ASSIGN' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'Stage_Members_5') AS PDS_CAREADVANCE_CM_ASSIGN_ContainerName,
(SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'PDS_CAREADVANCE_CM_ASSIGN_FileName' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'PDS_Load_CareAdvance_CM_ASSIGN' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'Stage_Members_5') AS PDS_CAREADVANCE_CM_ASSIGN_FileName,
(SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'PDS_CAREADVANCE_CM_ASSIGN_FilePath' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'PDS_Load_CareAdvance_CM_ASSIGN' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'Stage_Members_5') AS PDS_CAREADVANCE_CM_ASSIGN_FilePath,
(SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'Stage_Members_501_source_ContainerName' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'PDS_Load_CareAdvance_CM_ASSIGN' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'Stage_Members_501') AS Stage_Members_501_source_ContainerName,
(SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'Stage_Members_501_source_FileName' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'PDS_Load_CareAdvance_CM_ASSIGN' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'Stage_Members_501') AS Stage_Members_501_source_FileName,
(SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'Stage_Members_501_source_FilePath' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'PDS_Load_CareAdvance_CM_ASSIGN' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'Stage_Members_501') AS Stage_Members_501_source_FilePath,
(SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'Stage_Members_501_sink_SchemaName' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'PDS_Load_CareAdvance_CM_ASSIGN' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'Stage_Members_501') AS Stage_Members_501_sink_SchemaName,
(SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'Stage_Members_501_sink_TableName' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'PDS_Load_CareAdvance_CM_ASSIGN' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'Stage_Members_501') AS Stage_Members_501_sink_TableName;

SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ UNCOMMITTED DECLARE @CURRENTDATE INT = CONVERT(INT, CONVERT(VARCHAR(20), GETDATE(), 112))  DECLARE @PDM_USER_ID INT SELECT @PDM_USER_ID = USER_ID FROM [APP_CAEDM].[DW_DIM_USER] WHERE FULL_NAME = 'PDM Auto Case'   DECLARE @CCM_USER_ID INT SELECT @CCM_USER_ID = USER_ID FROM [APP_CAEDM].[DW_DIM_USER] WHERE FULL_NAME = 'CCM Auto Case'  DECLARE @OPEN_STATUS_ID INT SELECT @OPEN_STATUS_ID = STATUS_ID FROM APP_CAEDM.DW_DIM_CASE_STATUS WHERE STATUS_DESC = 'OPEN'  DECLARE @POTENTIAL_PHASE_ID INT SELECT @POTENTIAL_PHASE_ID = PHASE_ID FROM APP_CAEDM.DW_DIM_CASE_PHASE WHERE PHASE_DESC = 'POTENTIAL'  SELECT DISTINCT M.SUBSCRIBER_ID +'00' AS MEMBERNUMBER ,DC.CASE_ID as CASE_KEY FROM APP_CAEDM.DW_FACT_CASE FC INNER JOIN APP_CAEDM.DW_DIM_CASE DC ON FC.CASE_KEY = DC.CASE_KEY AND FC.GROUP_CK = DC.GROUP_CK     AND @CURRENTDATE BETWEEN FC.EFF_DATE AND FC.TERM_DATE     AND ( 		FC.STATUS_ID <> @OPEN_STATUS_ID 		OR FC.PHASE_ID <> @POTENTIAL_PHASE_ID 		OR FC.USER_ID NOT IN (@PDM_USER_ID,@CCM_USER_ID) 		)      INNER JOIN APP_CAEDM.DW_DIM_MEMBER M ON DC.MEME_CK = M.MEME_CK AND DC.GROUP_CK = M.GROUP_CK
